scope.reviewed: The original 7E44..7E62 adapter and provider callback 4860 execute without interception; 4860 calls actual AA2C. All 18 fixtures reproduce exact callback arguments, successful return, copied bytes, untouched destination suffix, SP and stop PC. Inputs vary offset 0/17/64, two source bases, and lengths 0/1/128; buffers are nonoverlapping synthetic RAM.

limitations: Buffers and provider mappings are synthetic and nonoverlapping. Physical storage access, invalid pointers, address wrap and concurrency are not covered.
